courtName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York (S.D.N.Y.)

filings.title: Voluntary Petition for Chapter 11 Relief & Declaration of CFO Scott Haralson
filings.summary: Spirit Airlines files initial Chapter 11 petition in SDNY Court with $3.3B total debt. Includes Declaration of CFO Scott Haralson detailing Pratt & Whitney engine recalls and JetBlue merger block.

filings.title: Emergency Motion for Interim Approval of $350M DIP Financing Facility
filings.summary: Debtors request court authorization to access $350M in Senior Secured Superpriority Debtor-in-Possession financing provided by bondholder ad hoc group.

filings.title: Order Authorizing Continuation of Customer Loyalty Program & Credit Card Facilities
filings.summary: Court grants final order permitting Spirit to honor Free Spirit loyalty points, frequent flyer perks, and credit card processor agreements.

filings.title: Order Approving Joint Chapter 11 Plan Disclosure Statement & Voting Procedures
filings.summary: Judge Lane approves adequacy of Disclosure Statement outlining equitization of $795M senior notes and unsecured creditor recovery projections.

filings.title: Order Approving Section 363 Auction Procedures for Free Spirit Loyalty Brand IP
filings.summary: Court establishes bidding rules and Stalker-Horse credit bid procedures for the auction of Spirit's digital loyalty program assets and trademarks.

filings.title: Emergency Omnibus Motion to Reject 28 Unexpired Airbus A320neo Leases
filings.summary: Debtors move to reject 28 Airbus jet leases to curb $14.2M monthly cash burn following severe fuel-price escalation.

filings.title: Order Authorizing Orderly Wind-Down of Flight Operations & Liquidation of Aircraft Assets
filings.summary: Court approves cessation of all commercial flight operations as Spirit shifts from reorganization to orderly court-supervised asset liquidation.

courtName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey

filings.title: Voluntary Petition for Chapter 11 Relief & Declaration of CEO David Tolley
filings.summary: WeWork files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in New Jersey with $18.6B lease liabilities. Declaration of CEO David Tolley outlines master lease restructuring strategy.

filings.title: Emergency Motion to Reject 67 Commercial Master Office Space Leases
filings.summary: Debtors request immediate court order to reject non-viable master location leases in NYC, San Francisco, London, and Tokyo to halt $40M/mo burn.

filings.title: Order Approving Key Employee Retention Plan (KERP) & Lease Restructuring Framework
filings.summary: Court approves KERP compensation targets for restructuring specialists negotiating rent reductions across 400 global office hubs.

filings.title: Order Confirming Third Amended Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization
filings.summary: Judge Sherwood confirms WeWork's reorganization plan, eliminating $4B in debt and handing 90%+ equity control to SoftBank and Cupicus.

filings.title: Final Order Authorizing Lease Rejection Claim Distributions & Closing Chapter 11 Estate
filings.summary: Court approves final distribution of $42.5M cure claim pool to commercial real estate landlords and formally closes the Chapter 11 case.

courtName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware

filings.title: Voluntary Chapter 11 Petition & Declaration of CEO Laurie Ann Goldman
filings.summary: Tupperware Brands files Chapter 11 petition in Delaware with $812M in liabilities. Details decline of direct sales MLM distribution model.

filings.title: Interim Order Authorizing Cash Collateral Use & Continuation of Centralized Banking
filings.summary: Court authorizes interim use of lender cash collateral to maintain global manufacturing plant operations and payroll.

filings.title: Order Approving Stalker-Horse Asset Purchase Agreement & Section 363 Bidding Rules
filings.summary: Judge Shannon approves $45M credit bid floor submitted by senior secured lender group for Tupperware's IP and molding equipment.

filings.title: Notice of Successful Bidder & Confirmation of Section 363 Machinery Sale
filings.summary: Trustee confirms final webcast asset auction results for global plastics molding machinery and IP trademarks.

courtName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey

filings.title: Voluntary Chapter 11 Petition & Declaration of Chief Restructuring Officer Holly Etlin
filings.summary: Bed Bath & Beyond files Chapter 11 in New Jersey listing $5.2B in debt. Declaration details failed private-label pivot and inventory liquidation timeline.

filings.title: Order Authorizing Store Closing Sales at 360 Bed Bath & 120 buybuy BABY Locations
filings.summary: Court permits Hilco and Gordon Brothers to commence store closing liquidation sales across all nationwide superstore locations.

filings.title: Order Approving Sale of Bed Bath & Beyond IP & Digital Assets to Overstock.com ($21.5M)
filings.summary: Judge Papalia approves Section 363 sale of brand name, domain names, and customer data to Overstock.com.

filings.title: Order Confirming Second Amended Chapter 11 Plan of Liquidation
filings.summary: Court confirms liquidation plan transferring remaining lease claims and residual assets to 2023 BBB Liquidating Trust.
